frequency_question: How often can a complex cruise missile production line be established and rendered operational from scratch within 112 days?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign domestic transfers of complex cruise missile or precision-guided munition manufacturing setups. Excludes simple small arms, standard artillery shell production, or general maintenance facility upgrades.

cases.name: UK-France Storm Shadow/SCALP initial development and setup
Ukraine Neptune missile serial production setup
US/Allied transfer of advanced SAM maintenance lines to Eastern Europe
Rapid drone domestic manufacturing setup initiatives in Ukraine

coverage_note: 4 representative cases evaluated across aerospace and guided weapons programs.
known_gaps: Classified bilateral agreements and parallel fast-tracked defense projects lack public granular timelines.
skeleton: Complex aerospace engineering and missile technology transfer phases: 1) Legal/Technical Data Transfer (30-90 days), 2) Specialized Tooling and Facility Retrofitting (90-180 days), 3) Supply Chain Sourcing of Certified Aerospace Components (120-360 days), 4) Assembly and Quality Benchmarking (60-120 days).
multiplier: Minimum sequence duration: 30 + 90 + 120 + 60 = 300 days absolute physical minimum under parallel processing assumptions.
validity_reason: Aerospace manufacturing physics and supply chain lead times remain stable over medium-term horizons.
